name: legend
title: Legend
description: The key: what each color, swatch or line on a figure means. Written `@legend{[{Poor, c1}, {Good, c3}], key}`; a label is text with an optional mark (a swatch or a stroke) and an optional plate (a pill's shape), and a bare label is the default. The charts' own keys draw through the legend's key kernels (lib/core/legend-key.js, legend-svg-key.js); authoring them through `@legend{…}` lands one adopter at a time (engineering/decisions/2026-10-20-callout-placement.md § 6). Notes pinned to a mark are the callout plugin's: a `@legend{…}` span that pins one, and `legend: off`, still reach callouts as their pre-split spellings.
